spans.s: रद m. 1. Splitting, scratching; 2. a tooth, a tusk, घटय भुजबंधनं जनय रदखंडनम् Git.G.x.
रदन m. The same as रद q.v.

राद्ध a. (f. द्धा) 1. Propitiated, conciliated; 2. accomplished, completed, performed; 3. cooked; 4. perfect in magical power, initiated; 5. successful, fortunate; 6. obtained, attained, (pp. of राध् q.v.).

राद्ध a. (f. द्धा) 1. Propitiated, conciliated; 2. accomplished, completed, performed; 3. cooked; 4. perfect in magical power, initiated; 5. successful, fortunate; 6. obtained, attained, (pp. of राध् q.v.).
राद्ध-अंत m. a demonstrated conclusion, a dogma, a doctrine, वैशेषिकराध्हांतो दुर्युक्तियोगान्नपेक्षितव्य इत्युक्तम् S.Bh.ii.2.
राद्धि f. 1. Accomplishment, perfection; 2. success, prosperity.
